SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM TBL_KEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO, to_number(LEGACY_PO_SEQ)
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HYOS' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , TO_CHAR(LEGACY_PO_SEQ,'FM00000') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT , ADD_DATE , RD_DATE , PLANT AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , PURCHASER_USER_ID , REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , LEGACY_PR_NO||'-'||LEGACY_PR_SEQ AS LEGACY_PR_NO , REMARK , PLANT_NAME ||'^'|| PURCHASER_USER_NAME ||'^'|| REQ_USER_TEL ||'^'|| DELY_TO_LOCATION ||'^'|| INV_EXP ||'^'|| INSPECTION ||'^'|| CUSTOMER ||'^'|| COST_OBJECT ||'^'|| OLD_ITEM ||'^'|| BAN ||'^'|| DRAW_NO ||'^'|| DRAW_REV ||'^'|| COL_SAYANG AS IV_COLUMN FROM TBL_KEP_PO WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
UPDATE TBL_KEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
